steps.name: stage
argv:
import hashlib, os, shutil, urllib.request
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\guardcast2-0822\refs"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
want = "f78336496ce9d1c7f67978b58885e5f1ac259b532a2f8e4aed578af4080ef22c"
with urllib.request.urlopen("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olegmalk/banyan-city/main/taste/refs/guard1-canon-founder-0822-sq.png", timeout=120) as r:
    blob = r.read()
got = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
if got != want:
    raise SystemExit("!! guard-1 reference sha %s, wanted %s -- "
                     "refusing to condition on unknown bytes"
                     % (got, want))
first = os.path.join(dst, "guard1sq-s0.png")
with open(first, "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(blob)
for i in (1, 2, 3):
    shutil.copy2(first, os.path.join(dst, "guard1sq-s%d.png" % i))
print("reference verified", got[:12], "-> 4 slots (3 are byte-copies; "
      "dedup_cells drops them and one cell is drawn)")

steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
srcdir = r"C:\banyan-farm\guardcast2-0822\out-a"
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\courier-box\farm-out\ep2-guardcast2-a-0822"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
want = "06-the-clipboard-ipa-r0-w015-s0.png"
png = os.path.join(srcdir, want)
if not os.path.isfile(png):
    have = sorted(os.path.basename(f) for f in glob.glob(srcdir + "/*.png"))
    raise SystemExit("!! %s was not written; the dir holds %s" % (want, have))
src = [png] + sorted(glob.glob(png + ".*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest() + "  "
                     + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-guardcast2-a-0822.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) ->", dst)
